title: The lidar itself stopped: restarting its relay did not bring /scan back
summary: sensor.scan.stale on lidar confirmed at 09:14:03; diag.scan_relay.output_rate followed 0.4 s later and was muted as its symptom. restart-lifecycle-node restarted /demo/scan_relay, but the fault never cleared.

hypotheses.cause: The lidar driver stopped publishing (upstream of the relay)

recommendations.text: Check the lidar driver and its power: the relay restart did not help
